feeds.title: Decor8 Blog
feeds.description: Decor8 is an expertly curated guide for a stylish home and living. Holly Becker helps you to find your personal style, pull it all together, and create a space that you love. Her mission is to help you to find your personal style, become more daring and creative, and design a more beautiful place to live using what you already have.

feeds.title: Coco Lapine Design
feeds.description: The Coco Lapine Design blog by Sarah explores aesthetic Interior Decor Art exhibits and different styles in home design. Sarah is a Belgian designer living in Munich. She is passionate about graphic and interior design and uses this blog as a space to share everything that inspires her.

feeds.title: Smow Blog
feeds.description: The blog features posts on interior design, accessories, furniture, architecture, and more. Snow provides high quality designer furniture and accessories for the office and at home.

feeds.title: Kymo Blog
feeds.description: Follow the blog to learn more about interior design, color trends, and the importance of carpets. Kymo, from Kalrushe, Germany makes contemporary floor wear which is now sold in leading interior design stores all over the world.

feeds.title: HYPNOTIZED Blog » Interior Blog
feeds.description: I'm Helena. The interior blog category of the blog features articles on interior design, décor, tips, and much more. On HYPNOTIZED I show you my outfits, report on my travels around the world, and take you home with me in interior blog posts.

feeds.title: baunetz interior
feeds.description: Baunetz Interior | Design is a German-language online magazine. We combine journalistic content from interior architecture and design.

feeds.title: Pop-up-my-Bathroom
feeds.description: Information Platform for Creative Bathroom Planning, Architecture and Design. Pop up my Bathroom, an initiative of the German Bathroom Sector Association and Messe Frankfurt established in conjunction with the ISH, is an experimental platform for architects, bathroom planners, interior designers and journalists.

feeds.title: Designsetter
feeds.description: Designsetter is a Minimalist Design Lifestyle and Interior Design Magazine for Design Enthusiasts and Professionals.

feeds.title: Emicode Blog
feeds.description: Healthy living inside your home: Tips for building & renovation. Emicode is the seal for low-emission installation materials and construction products.

feeds.title: Heylilahey » DIY Home-Interior
feeds.description: This section features articles on interior design. Heylilahey is a blog with a focus on fair fashion and a happy and healthy life.

feeds.title: craftifair Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Antonia Schmitz, 35 years old, I come from Cologne and I am the founder of Craftifair.Inspirations for your home, original and challenging DIY projects, tips for unique shops and labels or simply beautiful things for a better life - you can find all of this here on Craftifair. Always with great attention to detail and a keen sense of aesthetics.

feeds.title: JOI-Design
feeds.description: For over 30 years JOI-Design has developed exclusive, design-oriented concepts for international hospitality, serviced apartment and office projects, and provided in-depth consultation services for interior design.

feeds.title: Look Pimp Your Room » Interior
feeds.description: I am Anette - Interior Designer and Blogger. The Interior section of the website features articles regarding interior design, décor and much more. Here in my living blog I collect my inspirations and you can see how we live and how our home is constantly changing.

feeds.title: LIGEA Blog
feeds.description: The blog gives more insights on interior design, planning, and carpet designs that will suit your living space. LIGEA realises the exact carpet design you envision for your major project, offers the most fitting product for your needs and provides you with recommendations and all relevant information within minutes.

feeds.title: MostWanted Interiors Blog
feeds.description: MostWanted Interiors is an interior design studio based in Berlin. Our approach is holistic, from concept to completion and very detailed oriented. Gabriela Postole is the main Interior Designer. Explore more on interior design in Germany, the latest trends and more!

feeds.title: CHRISTINE KRÖNCKE Blog
feeds.description: For more than four decades, the Munich institution of taste, CHRISTINE KRÖNCKE INTERIOR DESIGN, has been on a mission for stylish interiors. The entire Christine Kröncke Interior Design Collection is available to furnishing professionals and architects for 'self-planning' as 3D and 2D CAD planning models. Discover the latest trends in interior design, tips, remodeling and more!
